Hero_Desc_Ner:
The benevolent smile of the high priest of the Yggdrasil Order conceals something.
She is a perfectionist and strict with those around her.
She is always willing to go the extra mile when it comes to anything related to Yggdrasil or the Order.
Album_Hate_Ner: Anything that harms the Yggdrasil and Elias. Those who act irresponsibly, like abandoning their duties or shirking their debts.
Album_Wish_Ner: Watching Erpin confidently handle things alone.
Album_Ner1: The sprite priestess of the Yggdrasil Order. When listening to what she usually says everyday, she appears to hold significant authority. She serves as an advisor to Queen Erpin after all...
Album_Ner2: Ner gives harsh but kind-hearted advice to Erpin when she acts up, almost like a nanny. She has a knack for subtle insults, which no one is safe from.
Album_Ner3: Ner says the Yggdrasil she serves has a name called 'Eldr'. It's unclear whether this name was given by the priestesses, or told by the tree itself.
Album_Ner4: Ner believes that names and origins aren't as crucial as pure faith itself. Despite her prickly personality, the manner with which she speaks reveals a mature soul, making her stand out among the other sprites.
Album_Ner5: Not too long ago, I woke up to the sound of something rustling, only to catch Ner going through Erpin's bag without her knowledge. As I kept an eye on her, I saw that she was munching on Erpin's cake. That day, I realized that even Ner is indeed a sprite.
Album_Ner6: After witnessing Ner's excessive sweet tooth, she shadows me like a ghost, pleading to keep that night a secret. Despite my agreement to do so, she doesn't seem to believe me.
Album_Ner7: Ner seems to want to be a role model for Queen Erpin. She muttered something about her own terrible gluttony... and how if it were exposed, nothing could stop Erpin's own insatiable appetite. I understood what Ner meant, so I reassured her not to worry.

Master

make sure you're

LoveLetter_Ner:
Hello, Master.

This may sound a little out of nowhere, but lately I often find myself thinking how fortunate it is that you, and no one else, are the Master of our Yggdrasil Order. I hope you will continue to remain by my side—and by Her Majesty's as well. Oh, and before I forget, I did not receive your diary yesterday. You are still working on it, I assume? I shall be waiting.

Sincerely, Ner.
LoveCall_Ner:
Ah~ Hello, Master.

I sensed a little hesitation. You were not thinking of ignoring the call, were you? It would be troubling if you assumed I only contact you about Order business.

Why call if I am not urging you to work? Umm... Lately, while watching Her Majesty and the Order... I realized how hard you always work.

As someone working beside you... perhaps I never properly thanked you. That thought has been on my mind.

Saying it face to face would be embarrassing, while sending a message might seem insincere...

So I tried calling. How was that? You are not displeased, are you?

Master, thank you for everything, and... from now on too...! I look forward to working with you!
